We were unable to proceed with the commissioning process due to abnormal behavior exhibited by the charging station. Powering up the system took on average about 30 minutes. The XF3 router repeatedly connected and disconnected, while the XF4 router did not permit access and displayed a "Connection timed out" error. We attempted to replace the router as well as various cables, but these actions did not resolve the issue. Additionally, the SCB displayed a
"Fail Safe Mode Activated" error. Could this be indicative of a malfunctioning PLC, possibly requiring a CFast card reflash
Handing over this case to "eMobility TS SiD Team"

additional_info.subject: 0441347 - ID0441347-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370010] Issue with commissioning process CRM:00314000203
additional_info.body:
Buon pomeriggio colleghi,
Today we successfully managed to restore charger
Y2 / S1 313508370010
in Assisi and complete the commissioning. The charger was on FW v3.1.2 and has severe issues to boot up.
First, we managed to retrieve the dump data from the logs. I will forward them to R&D for further internal investigation.
Secondly, with a new USB Live Linux v2.1, we re-commissioned the charger by flashing the FW t v7.0.5 and restore configuration.
The charger booted up in failsafe mode. Router XF3 was running on the old Teltonika FW, and we updated it manually. Router XF4 was showing a very strange configuration, showing several different IPs (without 10.20.17.2) when connected directly to the router.
After router replacement and router XF4 configuration via Companion, the charger was completely configured and was restored after reboot.
Successful charging sessions were performed on both outlets.
Many thanks to Matteo for the onsite support and collaboration!
Buone ferie e Buon Ferragosto!
